affectedPublicSurfaces: GET /v1/demo/runs/{run_id}/events — workflow.completed vs workflow.failed for a partial-progress run
workflow_runs.stop_reason and workflow_runs.required_steps_completed — both change value for affected runs

journeys.name: partial-progress-is-not-a-failure
journeys.entryUrl: unit: complete one of two required steps, then narrate
assertions: required_steps_completed stays false — the partial fact is still recorded honestly

journeys.name: zero-progress-still-fails
journeys.entryUrl: unit: narrate, take the forced retry, narrate again
assertions: the ADR-088 defect signal is not weakened by this change

journeys.name: a-refused-write-is-not-progress
journeys.entryUrl: unit: a required write returning {'conflict': true, ...}
assertions: does not count as a completed required step
a run whose only required write was refused still terminates required_steps_unfulfilled

migrationCompatibility.notes: No schema change. workflow_runs.required_steps_completed (#1220) changes value for conflict-refused runs — correctly, since a refused write never performed the operation — but no historical row is rewritten and no column is altered.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: redeploy the prior release; partial-progress runs go back to being labelled failed, which is the current state

acceptanceCommands: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests/unit -k 'termination or forced_retry or status_mapping' -q
PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests -m 'not live and not demo_contract' -q
doNotInfer: Do not change when the forced retry ARMS. One nudge toward finishing the job is still correct on any incomplete state; only the terminal classification after the retry is spent changes.
Do not weaken required_steps_unfulfilled out of existence — the zero-progress case must still produce it, or ADR-088 decision 2's defect signal is lost.
Do not treat a conflict-refused write as progress. It names the tool but never performed the operation, which is the same rule the existing error/confirmation skips apply.
Do not write to any production shop. Sandbox only, never Fujiwa (2b1da87b-d0a8-46a6-b3c6-2132be0b5f4f).
